reusableCapabilities.responsibility: Resolve semantic actions against physical world objects with condition, power, authorization, reach, interlocks, jamming, damage, and event history.
Resolve reach, posture, force, timing, fatigue, injury, qualification, restraint, and Gesture variance.
Represent ideal action/pose guidance and compare actual execution without automatically correcting the actor.
Resolve component-local damage and dependencies into degraded functions, isolation needs, repair work, and acceptance requirements.
Model reusable work-order, isolation, lock/tag, stored-energy verification, repair, and return-to-service transitions.
Route station inputs through control laws into actuator requests constrained by installed capability and physical state.
Check part compatibility, interfaces, power, thermal, mass, loads, crew and maintenance constraints for configured machines.
Preserve source, custody, integrity, dependencies, claim-level confidence and contradictory evidence for records and summaries.

experienceOwnedDomains: raWWar factions, doctrine, campaigns, missions, authored historical events and contested public narratives
soldier, pilot, engineer, and commander identities, qualifications and relationships as game content
mech chassis, installed components, weapons, tools, mission roles, environmental envelopes, and faction engineering choices
specific power/thermal/mobility thresholds and consequences authored for each machine
specific lockout/tagout procedures, plant topology, energy sources, hazards, and operational authority
scenario data, physical world instances, art direction, and narrative consequences
manifestRules: The RuntimeManifest contains root bundle IDs and requested versions; it does not embed configuration bytes.
The catalog resolves roots and dependencies; dependency closure is not duplicated in the Experience manifest.
Missing external configuration means the MicroBundle uses its defaults.
Bundle numeric IDs and released versions are assigned by the owning package, never guessed in raWWar.
A capability is not reported as integrated until a separately owned bundle, consuming catalog, manifest root/dependency path, and executable tests prove it.
The raWWar experience root must not become a wrapper that privately implements every reusable capability.
The temporary PhysicalControlResolver is not evidence that generic physical interaction belongs in raWWar's product boundary.
No NuGet publishing is authorized by this contract.
integrationProofsRequired: A second non-raWWar consumer can load the reusable physical-interaction MicroBundle.
Keyboard, VR, controller, and NPC inputs resolve through the same semantic action and world preconditions.
Damaged, jammed, unpowered, unauthorized, or interlocked controls produce explicit outcomes and persistent events.
A configured mech consumes reusable control, component, damage, maintenance, and presentation capabilities without game-specific dependencies in those packages.
Engineering watch and LOTO scenarios demonstrate threshold logging, isolation, verification, repair, calibration, and safe return to service.
FSM_COS returns a RuntimeAssembly that the host actually uses; assembly is not mistaken for Experience execution.
